name: Custom Soundboard
description: Play your own sound effects when things happen in the game - player death, jumping, eating, being spotted by a lizard, falling, changing rooms and more.<LINE><LINE>One simple text file (soundboard.yaml) decides which sound plays for which event, with volume and delay for each. Add sounds right from the mod's options screen (in Remix, open Custom Soundboard and use the Add Sound tab: pick an event and a sound from dropdowns, press SAVE), or press OPEN FOLDER to find the file, drop in your own .wav / .ogg / .mp3 files, and press RELOAD CONFIG - no restarts and no rebuilding.<LINE><LINE>It comes with a set of example sounds so you can hear it working straight away. Your soundboard.yaml and your own sounds live in the game's data folder, not the mod folder, so updating the mod never wipes them.<LINE><LINE>Source, full documentation and bug reports: https://github.com/dion-hagan/rainworld-soundboard
